description:
Make the docs-mechanical package-content check (M8) assemble its throwaway package outside this repository, so the check works when `target/` is a symlink.

## Background

- `scripts/docs-check-package-content.sh` packs each profile package with `jit profile pack --output <repo>/target/docs-check-package-content.XXXX/<package>.tar`, then publishes it there with `jit profile add` to read the package manifest.
- On this host `target/` is a symlink (since 2026-11-03, 01:24), and `jit profile pack` refuses to write through it: "unsafe repository mutation target: target". Every docs-mechanical run on main has failed at M8 since then (first: c92f4011's run at 2026-11-03T23:29); M1–M7 and M9 pass.
- `jit profile add --destination` accepts only a path inside the current repository worktree, which is why the script used `target/`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The script packs each package into a temporary directory under the system temp directory, initialises a throwaway jit repository there, and adds and shows the package inside it; it creates, writes and removes nothing in this repository's tree.
- [hard] REQ-02: On this host `./scripts/docs-mechanical.sh` passes M8 with `target/` a symlink. Its findings and exit codes for dangling citations and prohibited content are unchanged, and the temporary directory is removed when the check finishes, passes or fails.
- [hard] REQ-03: No gate definition changes.

## Notes

- Owner ruling 2026-11-04 (relayed by just-in-time-6a): fix the script, not the gate. The assembly happens outside the repository because the gate-input walk applies no ignore rule, so a throwaway directory inside the tree could enter other gates' input digests while it exists.
title: Package-content docs check assembles its packages outside the repository
